lecture_title: Penrose Diagrams and the Formation of a Real Black Hole

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_02.png
assets.rationale: Unobstructed view of all four Kruskal regions and the fixed-radius exterior worldlines.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: near the horizon of the black hole.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_03.png
assets.rationale: Unobstructed frame containing the complete T-R board, both null-coordinate definitions, and the reduced radial origin.
assets.caption_hint: Null coordinates on the T-R half-plane

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_04.png
assets.rationale: Stable view of the compactified extended Schwarzschild diagram with the singularity and both exterior regions visible.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: diagram of a real black hole.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_05.png
assets.rationale: Clear view of the green spacelike slice through the extended geometry, the two-sphere grid, and the minimum radius r=2MG.
assets.caption_hint: Spacelike slice defining the Einstein-Rosen bridge

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_06.png
assets.rationale: Completed glued collapse geometry with the infalling shell, singularity, future null infinity, and backward-traced horizon simultaneously visible.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: If you're on the outside of it here, you can get away.

assets.name: lecture_08_figure_07.png
assets.rationale: Late unobstructed causal diagram showing the shell, horizon, and multiple spacelike slices used to define a time coordinate.
assets.subtitle_excerpt: Somebody falling through it doesn't experience it.
assets.caption_hint: Spacelike foliation of the collapse diagram
